instructions:
1. Sit on the edge of a chair and grip the front edge next to your hips.
2. Slide your hips off the chair and extend your legs forward with heels on the floor.
3. Bend your elbows to lower your body until they reach about 90 degrees.
4. Press through your palms to extend your elbows and lift back up.
5. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your back close to the chair to protect your shoulders.
2. Keep your elbows pointing back, not flaring out.
3. Lower under control and avoid dropping into the bottom.
4. Keep your shoulders pulled down away from your ears.
name: Chair triceps dips

instructions:
1. Lie flat on the bench with your eyes under the bar and feet flat on the floor.
2. Set your feet slightly wider than shoulder-width and drive them into the floor.
3. Retract your shoulder blades and pull them down into the bench.
4. Keep a natural arch in your lower back with glutes on the bench.
5. Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width with palms facing away.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Brace your core to keep a stable base.
2. Keep your feet planted and push them into the floor throughout.
3. Keep your head in contact with the bench.
4. Keep your shoulder blades pinched together for stability.
name: Chest bench press correct stance

instructions:
1. Grasp the parallel bars with palms facing in and arms fully extended.
2. Lift your body off the floor and cross your ankles behind you.
3. Lean your chest forward and bend your elbows to lower your body.
4. Lower until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
5. Press through your palms to extend your elbows and lift back up.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Lean forward to shift the work onto the chest.
2. Keep your shoulders pulled down away from your ears.
3. Lower under control and do not bounce out of the bottom.
4. Exhale as you press up.
name: Chest dip

instructions:
1. Sit on the seated dip machine and grasp the handles with both hands.
2. Place your feet flat on the floor and keep your chest up.
3. Lean slightly forward to load the chest.
4. Push the handles down by extending your elbows until your arms are straight.
5. Bend your elbows under control to return to the start.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Lean forward slightly to keep tension on the chest.
2. Exhale as you push down and inhale as you return.
3. Move under control rather than letting the handles snap up.
4. Keep your shoulders pulled down throughout.
name: Chest dip machine

instructions:
1. Sit on the edge of a bench and grip the front edge next to your hips.
2. Slide your hips off the bench and extend your legs forward with heels on the floor.
3. Lean your chest slightly forward and bend your elbows to lower your body.
4. Lower until your elbows reach about 90 degrees.
5. Press through your palms to extend your elbows and lift back up.
6. Repeat.
tips:
1. Keep your back close to the bench to protect your shoulders.
2. Lean forward slightly to bring the chest into the movement.
3. Keep your shoulders pulled down away from your ears.
4. Lower under control and do not drop into the bottom.
name: Chest dip on bench
